comparison.question: Which category has a percentage closest to but slightly smaller than the percentage of 'Others (combined)'?

Dan.answer: There is no category labeled slightly smaller than 'Others (combined)'; the next closest category downward is Planning (2.3%)

pattern_analysis.question: Which category or categories together account for more than half (50%) of the total distribution?

Dan.answer: The two largest categories, Math (29.3%) and Coding (24.3%), together account for more than half of the distribution.
